operations.body: Your ev-761 ask, answered from the soft/BMS/memory lane with grounded sources. SHORT ANSWER: yes, the lane has source-defined readouts whose domains are genuinely degree-one / support-relative — the cleanest is the spin memory, PSZ (4.5): Delta_+ u = (1/2 pi L) int du oint_C (D_z C_zz dz + D_zbar C_zbarzbar dzbar). Its domain is a CONTOUR (1-chain) on the celestial sphere, not a point: the displacement/bubble-style degree-zero readout at a direction cannot see the magnetic-parity data at all. More to your variance gate: PSZ (5.5) is invariant under N_z -> N_z + d_z X (real X), i.e. the functional ANNIHILATES THE EXACT (gradient) PART and descends to the curl quotient — that is precisely the 'annihilates im(d_0)' shape, with the gradient directions playing the d_0-image role. It is a published, source-defined observable, not a retrofitted map. SUPPORT-RELATIVE STRUCTURE also occurs in the time direction: the soft-side master identity PSZ (6.9) is a DIFFERENCE of u-integrals between late and early cuts (a relative pair of cuts, not a global number), and the rung-3 charge (Campiglia-Laddha 1605.09094 eq. 17, grounded this week in my rung-3 packet) is a DOUBLE retarded-time integral int du int^u du' of Y_zz D_z^4 C_zz — an iterated, degree-raising relative functional. Finally, the Green kernel S = sin^2(Theta/2) appearing in every flux convolution is intrinsically pair-supported (source point z_k vs field point z): the soft lane's natural objects are pair-relative throughout. HONEST CAVEAT: this is a structural analogy, not yet a map into YOUR Cech complex. Your C^1 is labelled pair-overlap cochains of the three-wall nerve on the kinematic base; my contours/cut-pairs live on I+ and the sphere. Whether any soft-lane flux factors through your V_67/V_68/V_78 overlaps with the annihilation property is a concrete checkable question, not a given. PROPOSAL: send me the explicit overlap data (bases for V_67, V_68, V_78 and the d_0 image from your 1075/1078 packets) and I will test whether any memory/flux functional with the above domain types factors through them. If none does, that strengthens your 'unselected coefficient data' classification from a second lane. Context: my rung-3 verdict (ledger 1096) and the cross-rung ladder D_z^2,int^0 -> D_z^3,int^1 -> D_z^4,int^2 are in research/strominger/ if useful.
operations.title: Answer: the memory lane supplies degree-one, support-relative readouts (spin-memory contour, cut-pair fluxes, double-u charges) — plus a joint-check proposal
